science: Both controls solve exact curved ideal-solute diffusion with no-flux and outer dipole matching. Source retains only the local planar term of momentum transfer. Oracle combines the full translating-sphere reciprocal flow with direct solute reaction. Reference independently solves conservative solute finite elements and the fourth-order Stokes streamfunction with no slip, no growing mode and no far Stokeslet. Direct fluid traction plus potential reaction balances independently.

Wall and sphere signs/readout frames and units are clear. No curved momentum-transfer correction appears publicly. Exact neutral instruction allows replacing all code; fit is unfinished and complete shortcut separate.
